text:
Maya: FYI Datadog SI asked for a short smoke plan for our observability integration (OTLP + dashboard + marketplace tile). Can we assemble a tiny checklist?
Ethan: yes - 1) minimal OTEL config, 2) dashboard JSON export, 3) runbook snippet for VPC/onprem. keep it <1 page.
Priya S: i'll handle the marketplace blurb and the partner-facing bullets (value props: traceability, cost-by-model, compliance).
Ken: i'll make the OTEL sample and a tiny Node demo that emits model spans. demo note: set REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true to include model, model_version tags.
Maya: include a short note about cardinality: only tag model_id and model_version by default; sample prompt_id at 0.5% to avoid explosion.
Ken: sample OTLP exporter we'll show:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Priya S: also add a one-line example for marketplace tile copy: "Redwood Inference — Production-grade model serving with Datadog observability. Quickstart: 5 minutes."
Ethan: for hardware partners we should show the air-gap path: bundle export -> transfer -> ingest. one bullet in runbook.
Datadog-bot: endpoint-check: OTLP reachable from staging cluster - PASS
Maya: timeline: EOD tomorrow for OTEL + dashboard drafts, Wed morning dry-run. i'll create a shared folder and post links here.
Ken: uploading demo artifacts now, will ping when CI passes.
Priya S: will draft blurb and a 3-item FAQ about PII, retention, and billing impact.
Maya: great — thanks team. short call tomorrow 9:30PT to review. :calendar:
